target: RWB-SVC-P3 database story and service catalogue
change: Allocate the rwb-case login name with grants on schema rwb_case only, no privilege on another schema, and record it in the service catalogue.
note: This story names no rwb-case login. The allocation belongs to the RWB-SVC-P3 database story.

target: RWB-P1-E1018-APP and the RWB-P3 exclusion screen story
change: P1 writes party_ext and account_ext by two PUT operations by business key, with all four party flags in the body. The screen keeps the confirmation and its audit. P1 enforces no role model (ASM-B-P1-07-E1018-3, AC3).
note: This story writes no extension table. The write path belongs to P1 and the exclusion screen.

change: Return product_group as the product_category value the view returned, unvalidated and unmapped. A value outside LOV-PRODUCT is returned as read, never coerced, dropped or defaulted (ASM-B-P1-07-E1018-6, AC1).
note: This story carries no product group, so the P1 read holds the rule, not this story.

change: Agree the field-level OpenAPI schema at baseline review: required flags per operation, GET /cases page and sort parameters, caseNo pattern and error codes per operation. Record it in the rwb-case API file.
note: The field-level schema of the rwb-case read is owned by the contract, not by this story.

target: Message catalogue and the RWB-P7-E1018-APP API specification
change: Write one sentence for MSG-P7-009 naming the field and case reference, and one warning for MSG-P7-012 naming the chain position, before wave 1. Add both rows to the API specification.
note: MSG-P7 messages belong to the rwb-decision service, not to this rwb-document story.

change: Restate DF-DEC-002 as an indexed business key with no foreign key and drop the recovery_case row of T3.3. State in T3.1 that the ALS business date is carried inside inputs_ref.
note: decision_log_entry belongs to rwb-decision (P7). This story has no ledger table.

target: Package ENTRY rule-row catalogue and the RWB-P7-E1018-APP registry fixture
change: Name the admitting rule ID of package ENTRY in the rule-row catalogue and copy that identifier into the registry fixture of the P7 story.
note: The ENTER rule ID is a P7 decision-log field. This story does not use it.

change: Keep the case tables in P3. Write party_ext and account_ext rows in RWB-P1-E1018-APP and read them back by contract.
note: This story writes only document tables. The split of the legacy case tables is P3 and P1 scope.

target: RWB-P7-E1018-APP API specification and TSD P7 T-A.2
change: Add finalCall to the query parameters of API-P7-006. Fix the creation filter answer as a page of entries with the thirteen named fields.
note: The ledger read is rwb-decision's API. This story does not read the ledger.

change: Publish the gateway-bff composite route for SCR-02 and SCR-03 with its path, the parallel calls to rwb-case and rwb-source-data, the merge order, the masking rules and the 2 s budget.
note: The composite route is a platform contract. This story only reads the document side of a case.
